_doc: Edge Discovery — Program 8 (Weekly CRT Sweep) variant of research_config_fx_metals.json. Tests the ICT/CRT weekly liquidity-sweep ontology (weekly_sweep_reversal) + falsification controls, on the same 5 FX majors as F-035 (XAUUSD deferred, same holiday-gap-gate rationale). window_size/warmup are widened to 2200 (vs. the FX toy default of 64) because detect() needs to see BOTH a full current ISO week (Mon+Tue accumulation, ~2 days of M15 bars) AND the regime_tercile_window (2000) trailing ATR history for the macro Direction x Vol diagnostic's volatility axis (RegimeLabeler, reconstructed with a WIDENED tercile_window rather than its own 480-bar default -- see weekly_sweep_reversal.py). This only affects trailing-history visibility per detect() call, not per-bar compute cost: the expensive regime lookup runs only on the rare bars where a sweep signal is about to fire. apply_signal_defaults is FALSE (diverging from the FX toy-family pattern) because the hypothesis computes its OWN range-width-derived sl_atr_mult/tp_atr_mult (target the opposite boundary of the swept weekly range) -- leaving this true would let HypothesisRunner.run_instrument() silently overwrite that geometry with the flat signal-block defaults below, which exist only for JSON-schema completeness and are otherwise inert. round_trip_bps/qualification/universe are copied verbatim from research_config_fx_metals.json for direct comparability to F-035.

weekly_sweep._doc: Genuinely new BEHAVIORAL knobs (CLAUDE.md section 6.5), read directly by the driver/hypothesis constructor, NOT by ResearchConfig.from_dict (same pattern as the existing 'spine' block) -- _require()'d at construction, no soft defaults.
